scientific_integrity: Full real-parameter proof via six support inequalities, plus standard-library exact rational verifier. No claimed independent proof certification or publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for strictly convex six-edge polygons with parallel opposite sides; does not cover arbitrary even polygons. One related 2026 area-energy preprint could be inspected only at abstract level; older unindexed equivalent work remains possible. Finite verification is not an infinite proof.
title: Exact Minkowski asymmetry and unique critical point of parallel-opposite hexagons
